confidence: Exact Clopper-Pearson intervals, alpha/K for fixed look; alpha/(K*4) for all four looks. Shared draws across8 fixed queries; optional stopping only at declared looks. Not a navigation or model-calibration guarantee.
promotion_gate: Development: zero false-safe; unresolved fraction at most fixedCP20000+0.02; mean batch time at most0.8*fixedCP20000. Vehicle promotion additionally requires benefit beyond deployable analytic CDF and non-analytic prediction validation; neither may be assumed.
holdout_policy: All inputs/configurations frozen before execution; constructed unseen parameter combinations only, not unseen maps. Gate uses development only; holdout results cannot tune parameters.
